test_ray: test the ray function to find the closest geom intersection given a ray origin and direction
test_ray_geom: test the ray_geom function to compute ray intersection distance for a primitive geom type
test_ray_quad: test the _ray_quad function to solve a quadratic equation for ray intersection parameters
test_ray_capsule: test the _ray_capsule function to compute ray intersection with a capsule geom
test_ray_mesh: test the _ray_mesh function to find the best ray intersection across all mesh faces
